title: Boundary
decision: CRM canonical F-IDs are traceability anchors; implementation remains capability-oriented and cross-module writes use public contracts/orchestration.
rationale: Derived from Pass 1 repository audit, official benchmark research and v3 architecture rules.
alternatives_considered: Feature-folder implementation or direct private-table coupling rejected.

title: Ai
decision: AI is permissions-aware assist/recommend/generate capability; deterministic ERP state transitions and business commands remain authoritative.
rationale: Derived from Pass 1 repository audit, official benchmark research and v3 architecture rules.
alternatives_considered: Feature-folder implementation or direct private-table coupling rejected.

title: Security
decision: Authorization is server-side and layered by organization/company/team/owner/record/field/content; aggregated/search/AI surfaces may not leak hidden data.
rationale: Derived from Pass 1 repository audit, official benchmark research and v3 architecture rules.
alternatives_considered: Feature-folder implementation or direct private-table coupling rejected.

title: History
decision: Stage, assignment, probability, close, conversion, merge and forecast history is append-oriented/reproducible; configuration changes do not rewrite historical truth.
rationale: Derived from Pass 1 repository audit, official benchmark research and v3 architecture rules.
alternatives_considered: Feature-folder implementation or direct private-table coupling rejected.

title: Accessibility
decision: CRM targets WCAG 2.2 AA with keyboard parity, visible focus, non-drag alternatives and responsive critical workflows.
rationale: Derived from Pass 1 repository audit, official benchmark research and v3 architecture rules.
alternatives_considered: Feature-folder implementation or direct private-table coupling rejected.

title: Quotation
decision: Sales owns quotation truth; CRM supplies opportunity context through an idempotent public-contract handoff and must not implement quotation pricing/tax logic.
rationale: Derived from Pass 1 repository audit, official benchmark research and v3 architecture rules.
alternatives_considered: Feature-folder implementation or direct private-table coupling rejected.
